title: img2threejs/img2threejs
claim: img2threejs/img2threejs — Rebuild the object in a reference image as a code-only, procedural, quality-gated, animation-ready Three.js model. Token
why_good: Takes a reference image and outputs a TypeScript factory function that procedurally rebuilds the object using Three.js primitives and shaders, ready for animation.
value: Game studios and e-commerce sites pay for instant, custom hard-surface assets without licensing fees.
risk: It risks becoming a niche library if it doesn't solve the 'download' friction for non-coders.
does: Takes a reference image and outputs a TypeScript factory function that procedurally rebuilds the object using Three.js primitives and shaders, ready for animation.
why_use: It bypasses the slow photogrammetry pipeline and generic asset packs, delivering a unique, animation-ready model instantly.
gap: It is a CLI tool that requires coding knowledge to use the output, excluding non-technical users.
counter: Three.js is the incumbent; this is merely a helper library, not a standalone product.
differentiator: Wrap the CLI in a browser-based UI where designers upload images and download the `.glb` directly, hiding the code.
hook: Hard-surface 3D artists and game devs who need specific assets without downloading heavy files or hiring a modeler.

zh.hook: 硬表面3D艺术家和游戏开发者，需要特定资产却不想下载重型文件或雇佣建模师。
zh.does: 输入参考图，输出TypeScript工厂函数，用Three.js基元和着色器程序化重建物体，支持动画。
zh.why_use: 跳过耗时的摄影测量流程和通用的素材包，直接获得独特的、可动画的模型。
zh.gap: 只有开发者能用；当前的CLI/代码输出对非技术设计师是门槛。
zh.counter: Three.js是 incumbent；这只是个辅助库，不是独立产品。
zh.differentiator: 把CLI包装成浏览器UI，设计师上传图片直接下载.glb，隐藏代码。
zh.value: 游戏工作室和电商网站为无需授权费的即时、定制化硬表面资产付费。
zh.risk: 如果不能解决非程序员的“下载”摩擦，就会沦为小众库。
zh.why_good: 输入参考图，输出TypeScript工厂函数，用Three.js基元和着色器程序化重建物体，支持动画。
zh.claim: img2threejs/img2threejs — 将参考图像中的物体重建为纯代码、程序化、质量可控、可直接用于动画的 Three.js 模型。Token

consumer_angle: A no-code web app for 3D artists and marketers to generate animation-ready 3D assets from images without writing code.
pick_reason: Massive demand (715 forks) for 3D generation, but the current tool is too technical for the average user.
